messages:
amanda: heads up — I'm seeing a lot of near-duplicates across en/ja/ko in the international ingest. Tokenizer segmentation mismatch is causing divergent fingerprints and a bunch of false dupes. Also found some PII slipthrough in the ja set.

jia: can you paste a couple sample ids? I can run the overlap script and check tokenizer deltas. also which quant artifact did you evaluate for the intl run?

amanda: sample ids: S-2026-0142, S-2026-0229, S-2026-0301. quant candidate: q4_0-intl-2026-03 (quick CPU emu run). Observed more hallucinations on zh/ja completions vs baseline.

mateo: for CJK deid we should do unicode-normalize + strip interpunct/zero-width spaces before tokenizing. i'll prototype a small fix.

label-bot: Automated QC report: overlap rates: en↔ja = 18%, ja↔ko = 12%. potential pii hits flagged = 42 samples. golden-candidate pool flagged = 24.

jia: proposal — small golden refresh: 40 samples total (10 per locale + 10 wildcard), prioritize tokenization edgecases. timeline ok?

amar: can take 10 samples during JST morning. will do manual de-id + audit.

mateo: opening a pipeline patch to add unicode normalization + sentencepiece postprocess. quick patch:
```diff
- fingerprint = hash(tokenize(text))
+ text = normalize_unicode(text)
+ text = remove_zero_width(text)
+ tokens = sp.encode(text)
+ fingerprint = hash(tokens)
```

amanda: target: golden refresh + rerun eval by Fri EOD. If patch helps, we rerun q4_0-intl and q8_0 candidates. Also add a unit test for CJK deid.

jia: tasks: amanda -> aggregate failing outputs + attach model logs; mateo -> PR for dedupe pipeline; amar -> manual deid & relabel 10; jia -> run dedupe + post overlap report; label-bot -> post results when done :rocket: 

amanda: linking eval dashboard: https://redwood.infra/evals/intl-2026

srebot: deploy scheduled: dedupe-patch canary -> 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC

amar: noted, coordinating with JST labelers. :thumbsup:
